e-reply-by-email.1.evidence: PARTIAL: Settings > Reply by Email with Enable + Inbound webhook method saved -> notice "Reply by Email settings saved."; there is NO domain-and-signing-secret input (secret is auto-generated, email domain defaults to forums.local); IMAP password "Leave blank to keep" placeholder NOT PERFORMED (IMAP fields are hidden in webhook mode, placeholder empty when no password stored)

e-reply-by-email.2.evidence: after enabling, alice replies produced notification emails to bob with Reply-To reply+<token>@... and the token differs per post (p=8989 vs p=9023 decoded from the two Reply-To values); per-user difference not compared

e-reply-by-email.3.evidence: signed (Mailgun-style timestamp/token/signature fields) POST /reply-by-email/inbound with bob token and "Thanks, restarting the queue worker fixed it for me." -> 200 {"success":true}; reply 16436 created on topic 8989 with author_id 3755 (bob), status publish. Notification delivery for that reply not separately inspected

e-reply-by-email.4.evidence: body with "> On Mon, Alice wrote:" quoted lines and a "-- " signature -> stored reply 16437 contains only "First paragraph... \n\nSecond paragraph with detail." (quote and signature stripped, paragraph break kept)

e-reply-by-email.5.evidence: invalid token -> 400 jetonomy_reply_token_invalid "Invalid token structure."; expired token -> 400 jetonomy_reply_token_expired "Reply token has expired."; no reply rows created

e-reply-by-email.6.evidence: PARTIAL: tampered expiry and tampered user id -> 400 jetonomy_reply_token_invalid "Token signature mismatch."; replaying a bob token against a different post id NOT PERFORMED (post id is inside the signed token)

e-reply-by-email.7.evidence: unsigned -> 403 jetonomy_webhook_missing_signature "Webhook request is not signed."; wrong signature -> 403 jetonomy_webhook_signature_invalid "Webhook signature mismatch."; timestamp 2h old -> 403 "Webhook timestamp is outside the accepted window."; empty secret -> 403 jetonomy_webhook_not_configured "Inbound webhook is not configured with a signing secret."

e-reply-by-email.8.evidence: extension setting disabled -> 503 jetonomy_extension_disabled "Reply by Email is not enabled."; method set to IMAP while webhook is called -> 400 jetonomy_inbound_method_disabled "Inbound webhook method is not enabled."

e-reply-by-email.9.evidence: no To -> 400 "No To address found in payload."; To without token -> 400 "No reply token found in To address."; empty body -> 400 "Email body is empty."

e-reply-by-email.10.evidence: bob inbound replies hit 429 jetonomy_rate_limited "Rate limit exceeded or content empty." after 7 accepted replies in the window (runbook says after more than 10; the limit is lower or shared with the free reply limiter); other-member unaffected case NOT PERFORMED

e-reply-by-email.11.evidence: valid token for silenced finn -> no reply row created; endpoint still answers 200 {"success":true}; finn is sent a "Your emailed reply was not posted" bounce email (runbook expected no bounce)

e-reply-by-email.12.evidence: PARTIAL: valid token for space-banned omar on Off-Topic Lounge topic 5764 -> no reply row, 200 success:true, omar got "Your emailed reply was not posted" bounce; the closed topic "Scheduled maintenance on Saturday" and archived Hackathon space cases NOT PERFORMED

e-reply-by-email.13.evidence: valid token for bob on CAB topic 5865 (not a member) -> no reply created; response is the same 200 {"success":true} as a normal accepted reply, with a generic bounce email "Your emailed reply was not posted" (no topic title leak)

e-reply-by-email.14.evidence: NOT PERFORMED: held-reply (approval required) and rule-flag via inbound email not exercised
